wish: someone should make an app that is drawing software for amateurs
spec:
A blank page you draw on with finger, mouse or stylus: pen, see-through marker, eraser, three sizes, six colors plus any color.
Draw, undo or redo any stroke, clear (also undoable), and save the page as a PNG; the drawing is kept between visits.
It does not do layers, shapes, text, fill bucket or opening existing images.
notes: Stylus pressure varies pen width. Ctrl/Cmd+Z undo, Shift to redo. Strokes kept in localStorage.
